title: The Dark Truth About Inquisitor (tabletop game) #Shorts
description:
Evolution does not optimize for happiness — Inquisitor (tabletop game) shows exactly where that breaks. Inquisitor is a 2001 tabletop miniatures game based in Games Workshop's Warhammer 40,000 (Warhammer 40K, or simply 40K) universe. Whereas the main line of Warhammer 40K games is based on squad based tactical warfare, Inquisitor focused on a small group of player characters akin to many role-playing games.

The honest version of Inquisitor (tabletop game) starts by giving up the comforting part. In recent years, a scaled down version has been created by a loyal group of players. Beyond the scale change, the game rules remain largely intact, but hardcore devotees can still find models and materials on reseller and auction sites.
